title: Maintainerr
name: maintainerr
description: Library tidier for Plex, Jellyfin and Emby. You write rules like "nobody's watched it in six months", it gathers what matches into a leaving-soon collection, then has Sonarr and Radarr delete it once the grace period's up. Source: https://github.com/Maintainerr/Maintainerr

env.name: TZ
env.label: Timezone
env.description: Like Europe/London, for when the rules run

note: Open http://<your-host>:6246 and pick your media server, then add Sonarr, Radarr and Seerr under Settings if you use them. There's no login at all, and its settings page hands out every API key you've saved, so anyone who can reach it can delete your media - keep it on your own network, or behind a proxy that asks for a password. Nothing's deleted until a rule's grace period runs out, so test new rules on a collection first. The database and logs live in the /opt/data volume. It sends an anonymous weekly usage report unless you say no when it asks, or switch it off later under Settings. Docs: docs.maintainerr.info
